provenance.source_url_or_construction_note: REJECTED PACKAGE — INVALID FAILURE ARTIFACT. physical-artifacts/raw.log is NOT an authentic historical failure observation. It is a single sentence quoted verbatim from the body of https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/1968 , whose title is 'fix(test): join subagent threads before mock assertions' and which is merged: that is, it is the fix author's post-hoc description of the failure, written in the fix PR after the diagnosis was known. The historical run itself is real and was confirmed (https://github.com/gptme/gptme/actions/runs/23841222952 , head_sha f48de363aa956caae8789a9b751d7631fd44fe3c, conclusion failure), and the declared revision is genuinely the run head and pre-fix, but no test-level historical failure artifact survives: the job log returns HTTP 410 (retention expired) and the only surviving Check Run annotation is a generic '.github / Process completed with exit code 2.' with no test-level detail. The Case therefore cannot be salvaged the way N17 was. Curator-only causal verification source, which must never be used as an Agent-visible failure artifact: https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/1968 .
